candidate_cases: A: Pollution prevention is the explicit governing concern, while the activity causing the pollution is context rather than a separately governed concern, so no secondary is necessary. B: Pollution prevention is the explicit primary concern, and the title also expressly and materially identifies fishing activities, which the codebook places under marine living resources.
arbitration_rationale: Option B is better supported because the title explicitly combines prevention of marine pollution with fishing activities; the former controls as primary and the latter is a material, codebook-defined secondary concern.

arbitration_rationale: Option A is better supported because the title does not identify tourism, visitors, or non-governmental actors; its express subject is general expeditionary operations without a safety focus.
